nodes.title: Подключить существующие кадры хранилища
nodes.outcome: Кандидат Fansly получает упорядоченные URL кадров из канонического frame pack по точной связке post → attachment → media_id.
nodes.detail: Использовать fansly_vault_media_local_files и B2 prefix gofanly-backups/vault-frames. Не читать fansly_post_media_frames: это другой набор. При отсутствующем media_id вернуть пустую последовательность; не угадывать данные и не запускать backfill.
context: Candidate identity: read-service candidate_id = SHA1(platform | creator_id | source_post_id | scoring_version | hourBucket)
Frame join: fansly_posts.id → fansly_post_attachments.post_id → media_id → fansly_vault_media_local_files
nodes.proof: Authoritative CRM-v0/main 94e11eb3bae35be7b7f97ed27a73842e8d01954c; focused route/service suite 9/9 passed, including actual SQLite execution against migrations 010/268/302, exact candidate route resolution, attachment ordering, canonical key/media_id checks, and null-media fail-closed behavior. Creator identity is bound by CandidateResolver's exact deterministic candidate_id (creator_id + source_post_id); the SQLite fansly_posts schema has no account_id field.
nodes.task: Use the exact existing candidate identity seam: CandidateResolver resolves the deterministic candidate_id produced from creator_id + source_post_id; then bind source media through fansly_posts.id = fansly_post_attachments.post_id, select the first frame-bearing media_id by pos/account_media_id, and read only that media_id's ordered vault frames. Migrations 010/268/302 prove fansly_posts has no account_id column, so do not invent an account_id filter or schema. Restrict object keys to vault-frames/frames/<same media_id>_<NN>.jpg and the fixed b2-backups:gofanly-backups/ remote; missing media_id and invalid keys fail closed.

workerContract.writeZone: Existing frame sequence service and its focused test only

resolvedBlocker.message: Prior projection used a different frame table and did not read the canonical vault frame pack for the exact candidate source post.
resolvedBlocker.evidence: Current SQLite migrations 010/268/302; fansly_posts has id but no account_id. Candidate identity is resolved from deterministic candidate_id derived from creator_id + source_post_id before exact post_id attachment lookup.
resolvedBlocker.clearsWhen: Use exact CandidateResolver identity, exact fansly_posts.id/post_id attachment chain, bounded canonical vault keys, and focused SQLite-backed tests.
resolvedBlocker.resolution: Integrated on CRM-v0/main. Candidate-to-creator identity is enforced through the existing deterministic candidate resolver; the frame query uses the exact source post id because the current SQLite schema has no fansly_posts.account_id column.

reconciliationHistory.finding: The original ordered-frame contract failure came from a checkout before CRM-1 integration; its code is present in current main.

reconciliationHistory.evidence: Current CRM-1 reads fansly_post_media_frames/gofanly-media. CRM audits identify the Luna vault frame pack in fansly_vault_media_local_files and canonical B2 path gofanly-backups/vault-frames; the old table has no Luna rows.

CRM CLAUDE/session-claim instructions require OPUS_PLAN/assignment and session-claim for this mutation. The current owner explicitly directed the isolated Graph Runner fast path and rejected importing that legacy machinery. No product blocker is implied by that rule.

First fast-path commit b23ab38 wires the correct vault table and fixed backup bucket, but source review found it does not bind post_id to the candidate creator account, does not reject b2 keys outside the exact vault frame prefix/media_id, and globally drops duplicate variant indexes across multi-attachment posts. Reopen the same node against the bounded commit for exact source binding.

Independent review found the added join assumes fansly_posts.account_id in SQLite. Tracked migration 011_fansly_data.js and migration 010-fansly.sql omit that column, despite later code/comments assuming it. Bind by the already resolved candidate's exact source_post_id/creator_id seam and verify the attachment/vault SQL against the actual tracked 268/302 schemas; do not add a schema migration. JPEG SOI/EOI validation is present in 41442f9 and must remain covered.

Commit 94e11eb executes vault selection against tracked SQLite migrations 010/268/302; CandidateResolver supplies the exact owner-scoped candidate source_post_id/creator_id. Focused proof 8 passed; existing route integration is environment-blocked at listen EPERM.
reconciliationHistory.integration: PR #19376 is open from codex/craftnode-crm1-vault-frames. Normal GitHub merge is blocked by protected main policy; --admin was not used.

reconciliationHistory.finding: The prior graph task required fansly_posts.account_id, but authoritative migration 010 does not define that column. Commit 94e11eb added migration-backed proof and removes the invalid predicate.
reconciliationHistory.identityBinding: CandidateResolver exact candidate_id (creator_id + source_post_id), followed by exact post_id → attachment → media_id join.
reconciliationHistory.proof: 9/9 focused tests passed, including actual migration-backed SQLite and route coverage.

executionGate.reason: Bounded vault-frame projection integrated at CRM-v0/main 94e11eb3bae35be7b7f97ed27a73842e8d01954c.

reconciliation.basis: Exact candidate_id resolves the current candidate (candidate_id material includes creator_id and source_post_id); the frame query binds to its exact source post. Current SQLite schema has no account_id column, so no schema/auth expansion is needed.

nodes.title: Подключить CRM operator session к Post approval guard
nodes.outcome: Одобренный оператор может открыть точный кандидат и план через существующую authenticated session.
nodes.detail: Post использует существующую CRM browser session: bearer gf_access_token в той же вкладке, обновление через текущий httpOnly refresh cookie и проверка пользователя через CRM /api/v4/auth/me. Approval hook передаёт bearer существующему Post guard; guard требует существующую CRM роль admin и затем проверяет exact candidate_id + immutable approved snapshot + единственную Fansly destination.
context: Существующий CRM login: sessionStorage gf_access_token и /api/v4/auth/refresh
nodes.task: Использовать текущий CRM bearer/session seam; не добавлять auth service, роли, ACL, ownership schema, creator binding или identity layer. Уже интегрировано в Post main; exact approval payload остаётся привязан к candidate_id и неизменённому snapshot.
nodes.proof: receipts/PFM-AUTH-1.json · focused integration proof 9/9 tests: unauthenticated 401, existing admin identity passes the existing session guard for the exact candidate/immutable snapshot, non-admin 403; source integrated at post-for-me/main 28955a67b37d10af61881219ce1862ef29dba0e8. No live approval decision was written.
nodes.ownerGate: Для live browser click требуется PFM-4 deployment; ❤️ разрешает только выбранный immutable plan.

reconciliation.basis: Existing CRM token, /auth/me identity and admin role now flow into the existing Post session guard; candidate and PublicationPlan bindings were already present.

reconciliationHistory.evidence: Owner-adjudicated single-owner policy reuses exact candidate/snapshot binding, but Post session shim returns null and CRM auth/me requires bearer JWT. Scope explicitly excludes building auth; no existing browser-session bridge is present.
9/9 focused integration tests pass; CRM bearer identity is checked through /api/v4/auth/me, approval is bound to the exact candidate and immutable snapshot, unauthenticated access is refused.

executionGate.reason: Existing CRM session/token seam is wired; live deployment remains PFM-4.

nodes.title: Связать план с точной целью
nodes.outcome: Одобренный план сохраняет точный lifecycle и цель Fansly, выбранные при одобрении.
nodes.detail: Сохранить точные lifecycle и цель на всём пути approve/read, чтобы Runner исполнял только подтверждённую привязку.
nodes.proof: Проверки approve/read подтверждают неизменную PublicationPlan и ApprovedPublicationSnapshot для точного candidate_id и единственной цели Fansly.
nodes.task: DONE and durable: authoritative Post main cc8e9c37ddbb06988b6e8330d193356c2d15e08a contains the equivalent canonical PublicationPlan/ApprovedPublicationSnapshot contract and candidate/plan validation. The originally recorded local commit 5aadb0f is not in remote history; exact durable evidence is now the remote main tree and head receipt.

nodes.title: Опубликовать по плану в Fansly
nodes.outcome: Runner публикует только lifecycle и цель из одобренного плана; неопределённый ответ Step-B помечается ambiguous без автоматического повтора.
nodes.detail: Использовать действующий production-проверенный Fansly provider. Сетевой timeout не подтверждает успех и не даёт права повторно публиковать или менять цель.
nodes.proof: Независимая финальная проверка PASS на 12a869ab37167e2bb63f794e60cbd61697e70d71: 196 целевых тестов, 773/773 pre-push проверок и 76/76 H3 проверок.
nodes.task: DONE: exact approved plan binding, one explicit Fansly destination, durable attempt receipt, ambiguity/no blind retry, and readable result from the latest lifecycle/attempt source are implemented and proven. See receipts/PFM-3.json.

workerContract.writeZone: approved plan bridge, lifecycle publish handler, existing runner and attempt ledger, focused tests

nodes.title: Доставить Post feed в live
nodes.outcome: CRM-1, PFM-2 и PFM-3 включены в main и доставлены в live действующим ограниченным deploy worker.
nodes.detail: GO получен на узкий deploy/root apply. Свежая проверка обнаружила, что готового host release и PFM root carrier на машине нет: установлен только отдельный UX playground service. Для live сначала требуется точный immutable artifact Post main 28955a67b37d10af61881219ce1862ef29dba0e8 и carrier, зарегистрированный существующим owner-approval rail. Host apply и вызов Fansly не выполнялись.
context: Post for Me issue #2 and curator update #5856224343 (2026-09-27)
Existing root owner-apply rail for app.gofanly.com /pfm-feed proxy
nodes.proof: GitHub API подтвердил authoritative Post main 28955a67b37d10af61881219ce1862ef29dba0e8. На host отсутствует PFM production user service / root carrier; app.gofanly.com/pfm-feed/ возвращает 301 на /dashboard. systemctl --user показывает только pfm-ux-playground-test.service: UX playground на 127.0.0.1:3220.
nodes.ownerGate: GO на install/activate PFM service и /pfm-feed proxy получен. Нужна регистрация и owner approval одного hash-pinned PFM deployment carrier через существующий root rail; прямой systemctl/Nginx обход запрещён.

workerContract.allowedBeforeGate: Read-only verification and user-owned artifact staging only.

executionGate.reason: Owner GO получен; execution ждёт отсутствующий hash-pinned PFM deployment carrier и materialized artifact для authoritative SHA 28955a67b37d10af61881219ce1862ef29dba0e8.

nodes.title: Проверить полный сценарий на телефоне
nodes.outcome: На телефоне пройден путь: лента → просмотр плана → одобрение → публикация в точную цель Fansly → видимый PublicationResult, связанный с выбранными lifecycle и destination.
nodes.detail: Единственный конечный узел программы. Одобрение в приложении подтверждает план; реальную внешнюю публикацию отдельно разрешает владелец.
context: Интегрированные ветки approval, PublicationPlan и dual media
nodes.proof: Зафиксировать мобильный путь, точную цель и видимый PublicationResult, связанный с receipt публикации.
nodes.ownerGate: Нужно отдельное явное разрешение владельца перед реальной внешней публикацией в Fansly.
